thesis: Mohnish Pabrai argues that investors must separate the basic economics of a business from the personal flaws of its management, citing Charlie Munger's regret over undervaluing the Belridge oil field due to the CEO's alcoholism. He suggests that while Turkey faces significant macro issues like high inflation and poor monetary policy, individual businesses may still offer value if one can ignore the country-level problems and focus on the underlying economics.
